license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable transcription from the official CCC2021 CC BY4.0 published version, article31, 2021-07-08. Theorem4 and its formal Corollary24 conclusion are one constant-round deterministic protocol-size hardness result. Full three-round Boolean-matrix construction, chromatic-number gap prerequisite, large-alphabet warmup, cost characterization, deterministic fooling-set round elimination and approximation reduction proofs are retained with original numbered statements. Original total Boolean NxN input, constant round/approximation conditions, Alice/Bob-first conventions and model definitions are retained. Original mathematical expressions and reduction-time wording are transcribed without author-proof correction or added assumptions. The complementary leaf-set overlines were read from official p31:18; typography-only line breaks preserve all terms. All65 official bibliography entries retained. Randomized/conditional extensions in Sections6--7 are not claimed by this deterministic item; the full official original remains available. Supporting statements and direct consequences are not counted separately.

core_obligations: Preserve total Boolean NxN matrix input, constant number of rounds and approximation factor.
Keep complete Boolean construction and deterministic round-elimination/approximation-reduction proof chain.
Do not split warmup, three-round base, fooling-set or direct final consequences into separately counted tasks.
difficulty_reason: The author reduction controls three-round protocol leaf count via coloring and universal Boolean matrices, then uses a special XOR-equality direct-sum gadget with a good-input/fooling-set dichotomy to eliminate deterministic rounds with polynomial input growth. The approximation-oracle reduction carries the hardness to every fixed round count. These are explicit nonroutine combinatorial mechanisms.
